ops.title: Rework 1 — pin the allowlist, correct the history-line docstring
ops.imperative: Two bounded follow-ups from Commander r418-460 after g1-review returned APPROVE, both inside the existing allowed scope. (1) Add a test assertion pinning RESTATE_ALLOWED_FIELDS to its exact expected tuple, so a later widening of the allowlist — the reviewer's mutation M4, which adds an `original` key and has the applier prefer op['original'] over the parsed statement, and which currently runs GREEN at 21 passed exit 0 — cannot silently reopen the evidence-destruction risk this op exists to close. Prove the new assertion drives red under exactly that mutation, with numbers. (2) Correct the _restatement_history_line docstring: it claims the original is an unambiguous tail needing no knowledge of the reason's wording, but a reason containing the marker text yields two markers on one line. The real original survives verbatim as the LAST marker, so nothing is destroyed — state that truth in one or two sentences. Do NOT change the line format and do NOT add escaping. Then re-run the full suite and append a Rework 1 section to the existing result file; do not create a new result file and do not commit.

postconditions.statement: the allowlist-pinning assertion and the corrected docstring are in; the full suite is green with the real exit code captured
